structure: CSharp InferDynTraitConversion resolves canonical trait and committed method types, checks associated types then the shared method-shape predicate, selects exactly one implementation and publishes BoundDynTraitConversion. LLVM consumes only admitted conversion metadata. Native canonical dyn identity is origin16; its diagnostic adapter reads committed signatures and invokes the generated predicate before implementation admission and LLVM emission.
branches: Readonly self/no extra inputs/Int result accepted; mutable self, additional input and other result rejected; associated-type error precedes method compatibility. Five original positive/runtime-allocation cases and four exact negative diagnostics are unchanged.
logic: DynTraitPolicy is the single Boolean source. The generated region source SHA equals the actual CSharp policy. Native mask32 tests bit readonlySelf+2*additionalInputs+4*intResult, so only index5 (true,false,true) is accepted. This is source equivalence for all Boolean inputs, not eight additional executed runtime cases.
diagnostics: CSharp9 current compile/run and allocation/free checks pass. Native uses the same committed signature facts and exact errors; do not alter originals or dynamic type-ID numbers. TypeId interning order and whole type-commit/LLVM phases are outside this scoped policy association.

expandedSourceReview.type-commit: Canonical dyn trait identity and committed method shape feed compatibility admission. This does not certify TypeId interning order.
expandedSourceReview.expression-lowering: CSharp publishes BoundDynTraitConversion/Dispatch and materializes a two-pointer value. Native ordinary conversion facts and final dispatch seal supply the same concrete/trait identity to table allocation and slot selection.
expandedSourceReview.control-flow: CSharp indirect dispatch loads method ordinal+1; Native uses the committed dyn receiver and trait method slot, then the loaded method pointer. Runtime-context parameter representations differ; only the supported local readonly Int slice is qualified.
expandedSourceReview.ownership: CSharp allocates one payload per conversion and frees through slot0. Native emits the same conversion payload allocation and invokes slot0 at owner cleanup; expected allocations/frees pass in all five retained positive cases. Nested-owned conversion support is excluded.
expandedSourceReview.llvm-generation: Generated policy source hash matches CSharp authority. Exact method-shape and associated-type rejections occur before LLVM; runtime tables distinguish tested same pair, different concrete and different trait cases.

unqualifiedBoundaries: Imported trait namespace/symbol escaping collisions are not exercised by the local-trait fixtures.
Generic trait payload shapes, global diagnostic-order closure, full files/phases and non-Windows platforms are not qualified.
